image_prompt_override:
Generate one portrait 3:4 academic motivation figure for privacy-preserving visible-infrared person re-identification. Style: like a PPA paper motivation figure, not a flowchart. White background with subtle diagonal hatch texture; hand-drawn panel borders; dashed horizontal separators; bold Times-style serif labels; red problem annotations and red crosses; green check marks; lock, shield, person, body contour, clothing texture, pose structure, feature-stack icons. Use three stacked diagnostic panels. No global title. No caption. Panel titles must be plain words only. Do not use symbols such as ampersand, slash, plus, not-equal signs, arrows, hyphens, or punctuation inside panel titles.

Panel (a), blue border: title 'Cross Modal Consistent Anonymization'. Show RGB and IR person images. Coarse anonymization hides sensitive appearance but breaks useful ReID cues. Green check callout: 'Sensitive info hidden'. Red cross callouts: 'Broken contours', 'Broken fine grained cues', 'Shared structure damaged'. Show RGB anonymous feature stacks and IR anonymous feature stacks with a red bidirectional arrow labeled 'Mixed Gap'. Add small cause label: 'inconsistent RGB IR impact'.

Panel (b), gold border: title 'Key Controlled Secure Representation'. Do not draw Mixed Gap here. Show an anonymous image as a static sample. Red branch with attacker or no-key icon: 'Unauthorized use' and 'Identity leakage risk', red cross. Show a key controlled gate with lock key shield. Valid key branch: 'Authorized recovery' to 'Retrieval representation', green check. Small labels: 'Controllable', 'Authorized', 'Verifiable'.

Panel (c), green border: title 'Utility Security Feature Disentanglement'. Show key protected features entering a tangled cloud labeled 'Identity cues and key security cues'. Red warning: 'Feature entanglement' and 'Discriminability collapse'. Split into two branches: 'Utility identity feature' leading to 'Stable VI ReID retrieval' with green check; 'Security key feature' leading to 'Secure authorization' with shield check. Make this panel clearly green, not gold. Avoid generic pipeline appearance, face recognition task, NLP text document concepts, duplicated panels, and symbol heavy titles. Keep text short and inside boundaries.

figure.title: Motivation
figure.objective: Gemini image generation with plain panel titles and no symbolic title text.
